name: comp-444
title: Vertical Icon Sidebar Tabs
description: A vertical tab list beside a content pane. Picking Overview, Projects or Packages moves the highlight and swaps the text shown in the panel.
use: A few peer sections share one pane and a vertical list uses the space better than a top tab bar.
avoid: The panels are empty placeholders, so you must build the real content for each tab yourself.
a11y: Icons are hidden from screen readers and each tab is labelled by text; panel changes are not announced as a live region. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small vertical list of three tabs, Overview, Projects and Packages, each with a thin line icon, sits at the top left of a dark stage. A slim bordered panel beside it holds one grey line of text, and the active tab carries a short accent bar on its left edge.
behaves: Clicking a tab moves the accent bar to that row and swaps the panel text for the matching section. Rows pick up a faint filled background under the cursor.
customise: Tab labels, their icons and the placeholder panel text are written in the file, so changing sections means editing the source; no props are exposed.
weight: light: Three short tab rows and a one-line panel; switching is an instant DOM swap.
